items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever know George Schilling, Happy Schilling? Yeah. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Well now was this one of the earlier bands?

ctx.x: Matoya used to play with him. He played with white too, several times. Oh yeah.

Did you ever know George Schilling, Happy Schilling? Yeah. The white trombone player? He had a band, he called it Schilling's Black and White Band. Half white and half colored. They had plenty of bands. They used to play a lot of white bands then. Yeah.
Well now was this one of the earlier bands?
